lockHoleDatums.rule: one visible cabinet-side datum for each visible door lock tongue; copied historical datums must be removed or suppressed

shelfBands.rule: every visible shelf-weldment body must belong to a requested row boundary; historical 638/1248 mm shelf bands are not allowed

statusBoundary.note: A PASS closes the exact visible-structure contract only. It does not release drawings, DXF, BOM, supplier process, tolerance stack, load, coating, or prototype validation.

manualValidationStillRequired: shelf locating foot to front-frame notch physical fit and tolerance
external face through-hole topology rather than name-only detection
door sag, lock engagement allowance, weld distortion, coating allowance, and prototype signoff
